title: AMC 8 Practice: Area Inside Four Half Circles — Hidden Petals
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on finding the shaded area of a square with four half circles forming a flower, solved by slicing one petal. (Level 4 of 5)
Four half circles inside a square make a flower with four white petals. How much of the square is shaded? Vantee slices one petal into two pieces, then shows a faster trick: add up shapes that overlap, and each overlap gets counted twice. Then try a variant on your own!
